candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Data Engineering. Getting data from operational systems into reliable dashboards is exactly what I did in my previous roles, and I want to build on it with modern cloud data platforms and AI applications.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau (expected graduation September 2028) with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked in SAP data & analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea.

achievements.impact: I designed and implemented SAP Datasphere data pipelines and rebuilt a client's datasets end to end during a 42-dashboard migration from SAP BW
I built data models from ABAP CDS view sources and joins, and used SQL analysis, validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate
for my B.S. thesis team I built the Python pipeline that cuts highlight videos from model-detected events using FFmpeg

letter.problems_section: I would help build and test Python and SQL pipelines, add data quality checks, investigate failures and document my work. I have not yet used tools such as dbt, Airflow or lakehouse platforms in production, but moving from SAP BW to SAP Datasphere showed me I can learn a new data platform quickly.
letter.closing: I can work fully remote for 15 to 20 hours per week, starting immediately, coordinated around my studies. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
